text: レッドさん　２のしまに　いかれる　なら　これを　さしあげます

structure.jp: ２のしまに　いかれる　なら
structure.en: if you're going to Two Island

structure.jp: これを　さしあげます

patterns.name: 〜られる (honorific)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending here does not mean 'be done to'. It is a polite way to talk about what a respected person does. いかれる = 'you go' said respectfully.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a statement means 'if that is the case'. いかれる　なら = 'if you're going'.
